source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the combustion of benzene (PDF 69).

blocks.text: Jab benzene zaid hawa mein jalta hai to poori tarah carbon dioxide aur paani mein oxidise ho jata hai: 2C6H6 + 15O2 -> 12CO2 + 6H2O. Shola bohat dhuwein wala hota hai, jo aromatic compounds ki pehchan ke test mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Benzene ke jalne ka mua'adla balanced hai, check karein.
blocks.explanation: Baen: 12 C, 12 H, 30 O. Daen: 12CO2 mein 12 C; 6H2O mein 12 H; 24 + 6 = 30 O. Balanced.

items: 2C6H6 + 15O2 -> 12CO2 + 6H2O; dhuwein wala shola aromatic compound ki nishani.
